messages:
amelia: Heads up — I'm planning a small infra change to rotate the telemetry exporter creds in tenant namespaces. Goal: replace synced long-lived k8s Secret with IRSA (projected token) so we stop syncing secrets across accounts. Quick sanity check?

amelia: TL;DR: terraform will create an aws_iam_role + policy attachment, annotate the k8s ServiceAccount with iam.amazonaws.com/role, and remove the k8s_secret resource. Example snippets below — can someone scan for obvious gaps?

amelia: Terraform snippet:
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "telemetry_exporter_role" {
  name = "redwood-telemetry-exporter-ROLE-${var.env}"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.irsa.json
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "telemetry_exporter_attach" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.telemetry_exporter_role.name
  policy_arn = var.telemetry_policy_arn
}
```

K8s ServiceAccount manifest we plan to apply via Helm:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: telemetry-exporter
  namespace: tenant-xyz
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: "${aws_iam_role.telemetry_exporter_role.arn}"
    redwood.com/managed-by: terraform
spec: {}
```

amelia: Also removing this resource: `kubernetes_secret.telemetry_creds` and replacing consumers to use token-based creds.

sam: Quick notes:
- Make sure automountServiceAccountToken: true on the SA or pods won't get a projected token by default (some helm charts set it false).
- IRSA requires the IAM role trust for the OIDC provider; confirm the assume_role_policy includes `sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity`.
- Double-check any consumers that expect a file-backed credential (mounted secret) vs token-based auth.

jorge: Also watch for sidecars/old jobs that mount `telemetry_creds` as a volume. Those will break. Grep for `telemetry_creds` across k8s manifests and helm values: `rg "telemetry_creds" -S`. If you find any, we need a small adapter or keep a fall-back tiny secret.

tia: For canary: propose we do one non-prod namespace (`analytics-staging`) first. I'll run the exporter smoke test: verify TLS + token exchange and metrics emission. I can also run a 10m load to confirm token TTL refresh behaves.

amelia: Good. Two quick questions: 1) do we want to enable BoundServiceAccountTokenVolume feature (token projection expirationSeconds) so tokens rotate automatically? 2) If a pod doesn't have automount, do we toggle helm defaults cluster-wide?

sam: BoundServiceAccountTokenVolumes is GA in recent k8s; you can set `expirationSeconds` on TokenRequest when you create the projected volume — but most of our workloads will rely on the kubelet auto-injection (make sure kube-apiserver has `ServiceAccountIssuerDiscovery` configured). For Helm: I'd avoid flipping cluster-wide defaults; instead set `automountServiceAccountToken: true` in the chart values for the telemetry workloads.

jorge: Also: CI/terraform plan should include a short-lived migration: keep the old `kubernetes_secret.telemetry_creds` but mark it `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }` for the canary, then remove after consumers are updated. Safer than ripping it out in one go.

amelia: I updated the TF plan to follow that approach — leaving the secret with a `prevent_destroy` guard in staging, adding the IAM role + annotation. Plan looks clean, no drift expected. Posting the plan excerpt in the PR.

sam: LGTM from infra side. One more nit: add an IAM tag `env=staging|prod` so we can filter roles in console.

tia: I'll run the canary tomorrow morning. @amelia please ping when the helm values are pushed to the `analytics` chart repo and when the TF apply is scheduled.

amelia: Will do. Thanks all. :(flag-au:) 

infra-bot: terraform plan for PR #482 — https://ci.redwood.internal/plan/98234 — shows: +1 aws_iam_role, +1 aws_iam_role_policy_attachment, ~1 kubernetes_secret (prevent_destroy), ~1 kubernetes_serviceaccount (annotation added).

sam: Quick checklist for apply:
- [ ] Ensure OIDC provider exists and trust policy correct
- [ ] Confirm automount set in chart values for telemetry
- [ ] Grep repo for `telemetry_creds` and audit consumers
- [ ] Add IAM tags and logging permissions to role

amelia: I'll run through checklist and post back. If anyone sees an unexpected consumer please tag me. Thanks! :thumbsup:
